output.letter:
Aarav Mehta

I bring 4 years of experience deeply embedded in payments and fintech infrastructure, with a strong focus on building and owning backend services at scale — a perfect match for Razorpay’s Senior Software Engineer role on the Payments Platform team.

At Razorpay, I successfully developed the UPI mandate auto-debit reminders pipeline processing 12 million reminders monthly with under 0.1% failure. This experience honed my skills in Python, AWS services (Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB), and designing idempotent, reliable payment pipelines. I have also driven significant latency improvements by optimizing database queries through a Debezium CDC-enabled Redis read-model, a capability directly aligned with requirements using CDC for data-sync and performance.

Currently at CRED, I own a high-throughput rewards-ledger service handling millions of daily entries, where I reduced p99 write latency by 75%. I led the migration of batch reconciliation jobs to streaming using Apache Flink, eradicating SLA breaches and cutting reconciliation lag from hours to minutes, illustrating my distributed systems strength and concurrency handling. My introduction and adoption of OpenTelemetry tracing across multiple services further aligns with Razorpay’s emphasis on observability.

Beyond technical execution, I mentor junior engineers, lead design sessions focused on caching and idempotency, and produce exhaustive incident analyses and RCAs—expertise that will support your team’s collaborative growth and operational excellence.

I am eager to leverage my backend service ownership and payment-rail experience at Razorpay, continuing to deepen expertise in payment intent orchestration and webhook delivery. I look forward to contributing reliability-first engineering and learning from your fintech innovations.

Best,
Aarav
